info.name: API-Testing-ecommerce-store-31
info.description:
Tests for the ReqRes project ecommerce-store-31 (products collection).

/api/* uses x-api-key (manage key for admin CRUD, public key for auth). /app/* uses Authorization: Bearer <session token>.

    "List records: GET /api/collections/:slug/records",

exec:
pm.test("Status is 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("Response has data", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property("data"));
